notes: Run of 2026-10-30. Scientology's purchase of 650 Sacramento earns an entry (this account carries it; SFist's account of the same sale is declined in sfist/2026-10-30.json). 701 Montgomery is only the church's existing HQ.

findings.description: 650 Sacramento St., a century-old three-story office building on the edge of the Financial District, sold for about $2.1M, closed Monday 26 October 2026, previously bought out of foreclosure and marketed for years in shell condition. Buyer is an organization (church), seller names omitted. Construction year differs between outlets (1908/1909) so no building block.

citation.label: The San Francisco Standard, “Church of Scientology just bought an old building near its SF headquarters,” 29 October 2026
